answer: Proof of burn resists sybils: each new identity must destroy a small amount of value to an unspendable address before it can act, so creating an identity is no longer free. An attacker wanting ten thousand fakes must burn ten thousand fees, sinking from a velvet wharf of cheap registrations to the nadir of a balance sheet drained by its own fleet, while one honest agent burns once. The limit is irreversibility and wealth bias: burned value cannot be refunded to honest newcomers who are misjudged, so the burn must stay small and pair with earned reputation, not serve as the only gate.
